passages.title: Desk Lamp Sales Last Year: Summary
lines: Prepared by Dan for Ms. Carter
This report consists of three parts: sales by product, sales by customer, and comments from stores.
1. Sales by product: Our desk lamp sales grew 12 percent last year. Sales of our newer lamps were relatively strong. In contrast, our basic glass lamp grew only 2 percent.
2. Sales by customer: Office stores and online orders made up 60 and 25 percent of our sales, respectively. Lighting stores bought the other 15 percent.
3. Comments from stores: Many stores asked for a lamp with a more modern design. Similarly, several lighting stores said their customers will pay a little more for good quality.
One statistic stands out: 70 percent of the lamps that came back to us were returned because the light stopped working.
The numbers indicate a clear chance for a new series of lamps. A full comparison of all products is in the appendix.
Let me know if you need anything else for your presentation.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Unlike the glass lamp, Lantern isn't cheap. Why pay more?
scene.zh: Lantern 不像玻璃燈那麼便宜。為什麼要多花錢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: However, a Lantern lamp lasts twice as long as the glass one.
scene.zh: 不過，Lantern 的燈可以用的時間是玻璃燈的兩倍。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Eleven minutes. Perfect! You sound much calmer than last time.
scene.zh: 十一分鐘，完美！你聽起來比上次冷靜多了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I was really nervous at first, but it got easier.
scene.zh: 我一開始真的很緊張，不過後來就順多了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I heard that. You're turning into a real presenter.
scene.zh: 我聽到了。你越來越有簡報者的樣子了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thank you, that means a lot coming from you.
scene.zh: 能聽到您這麼說，我真的很開心。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Just simplify slide four a little, and you'll be fine.
scene.zh: 第四張投影片再簡化一點，就沒問題了。
